bio.text: Josh Shapiro, a Democrat, has been Governor of Pennsylvania since January 2023 and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary.
He served as Pennsylvania Attorney General from 2017 to 2023, chair of the Montgomery County Board of Commissioners from 2011 to 2017, and a state representative from 2005 to 2011.
According to Ballotpedia, he earned a law degree from Georgetown University and worked as a congressional staffer and attorney before holding office.
According to the governor's office, he grew up in Pennsylvania; his father is a pediatrician who served in the Navy and his mother is a retired educator.
